title: Transparent Vanilla Hotbar
description: Make the hotbar grid completely transparent and Vanilla-like
body:
**Transparent Vanilla Hotbar** is a tiny UI resource pack that makes hotbar slots transparent, leaving only a clean frame around them.  
It helps you see more of the world while keeping the vanilla-style borders.

**_If your are using "Default Dark Mode" Resource Packs, please move my resource pack "Transparent Vanilla Hotbar" above it, Otherwise, it won't work._**

**Features:**

•	Turns hotbar slots into clear, see‑through frames

•	Keeps the original gray border so the slot layout is still easy to read

•	Nice for minimal UIs, screenshots, and players who like a cleaner screen

•	Very lightweight: only edits the slot textures, no gameplay changes

**License / Permissions:**

•The Hotbar texture in this pack is my own edit of the vanilla asset.

•Do not re‑upload this pack to other sites.

•You may use it in videos or modpacks; a credit link is appreciated but not required.
